'''Embarkation Station 7''' was a hangar bay on the [[Arkadianate]] capital of [[Calimondretta]]. It was part of a cluster of domes on the surface of the planet [[Syned]] that was connected to [[Patriot Hall]] and the rest of the city by a series of southern underground corridors. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Station 7 was used to hold a [[Arkadianate shuttle|silver shuttle]] used to courier the captive [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]] to his grandmother [[Vilia Calimondra]], family matriarch of the [[Calimondra family]]. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]] was tasked by the Sith Lord [[Arkadia Calimondra]] with couriering the youth to Vilia's home.

During the [[Siege of Calimondretta|fighting]] created by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and [[Brigadier]] [[Jarrow Rusher]]'s successful escape, Narsk foiled a conspiracy by Arkadia to kill her younger brother by fitting his hoverchair with nerve gas. Narsk swapped the real one for a double and managed to escape with Quillan into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The station was damaged during a series of explosions triggered during the fighting.
